name: Gathering Echo
description: Gather the echoes of the legion round the student and read every soul in reach through them.

name: Fraying Double
description: Let a double fray into many threads of echo so that an opponent cannot tell body from thread.

name: Warding Wraith
description: Hold a warding wraith before the student as a screen that rebuffs a steady press of soul force.

name: Needle Phantom
description: Thrust a needle of phantom force into the soul of one opponent through the narrowest gap.

name: Legion Phantasm
description: Raise a legion of phantoms each wearing the student's face so that opponents cannot find the true body.

name: Legion Charge
description: Drive the legion at the opposing line so that a wave of soul-strikes breaks over every soul in front of it.

name: Husk Bulwark
description: Pack the legion's husks in a bulwark that withstands a hard sustained assault on the soul.

name: Pursuing Wraith
description: Send a wraith after a fleeing opponent that overtakes the body and strikes the soul from behind.

name: Chorus Wraith
description: Sing the wraiths in chorus so that their combined weight presses every opponent's technique to a crawl.

name: Vacant Passage
description: Empty the body of presence into the legion and pass through wards and walls to reappear among the phantoms.

name: Hungering Husk
description: Open a husk that drinks the soul force of a strike and feeds it into the legion.

name: Legion Apparition
description: Show the full apparition of the legion over the field so that every soul beneath it flinches and sinks.

name: Wraith Ruin
description: Loose every phantom of the legion at once so that the whole field is swept by soul-strikes up to the ruinous ceiling of a Core-tier soul and nothing weaker keeps its footing.
